range of about 2 km from base station to rover
unit.

ADCP – WORKING PRINCIPLE
An acoustic Doppler current profiler, or ADCP, is a device that uses sound
waves called the Doppler effect to measure the speed and direction of
currents throughout the water column. The ADCP works by transmitting
"pings" of sound at a constant frequency into the water. (The pings are so
highly pitched that humans and even dolphins can't hear them.) As the
sound waves travel, they ricochet off particles suspended in the moving
water, and reflect back to the instrument. The traveling time of sound
waves gives an estimate of the distance. The frequency shift of the echo is
proportional to the water velocity along the acoustic path.

ADCP – MAJOR COMPONENTS
POWER & COMMUNICATION MODULE 
(PCM) UNIT
The PCM of the ADCP system houses
rechargeable battery pack and enables
communications with a Personal Computer (PC)
or Mobile device through a Radio
Communication or Bluetooth, Differential GPS
(DGPS), (or direct PC connection to a PC).
Communication between the Transducer, PCM
and Computer can be controlled with a
Software.

ADCP – MAJOR COMPONENTS
SOFTWARE
A Compatible Software enables the integration,
set-up and configuration of various hardware
components. It uses the Data as acquired by the
ADCP for Discharge assessment and sensitivity
analysis along with detailed Discharge and other
Hydrological statistics.
The Software provides a unified quality
assessment framework using state-of-the-art
methodologies for uncertainty analysis and
statistical quality control, which helps gain
insights into the quality of the data.

‘आख्या’ (Aakhya) श्रेणी क्या है?
‘आख्या’ का अर्थ है कि प्रेषक अधिकारी ने किसी सन्दर्भ के सम्बन्ध में उपयोगकर्ता से रिपोर्ट / स्पष्टीकरण (report or explanation) माँगा है। मुख्यमंत्री सन्दर्भों में आख्या का आशय सक्षम स्तर से हस्ताक्षरित व स्कैन रिपोर्ट होता है।

1. प्राप्त आख्या से सहमन्त की दशा में उसको अनुमोन्दत करें । 
2. आख्या से सहमत न होने पर आपन्त्त क े  साथ वापस कर दें । 
3. अग्रेतर कायटवाही हेतु आख्या को अपने कायाटलय पर लंन्बत करें । 
4. अग्रेतर कायटवाही हेतु अधय अिीनस्थ कायाटलय को प्रेन्षत करें । 
क्या सभी संदभों की आख्या कायाटलय स्तर से भरी जानी है? 
नहीं । मात्र उधहीं संदभों की आख्या आपके  कायाटलय स्तर से भरी जाएगी, न्जनकी आख्या आपक े  
कायाटलय में तैयार की गई है ।

 Goods and Services Tax (GST) –  
indirect tax for whole nation, which will make India one 
unified market. GST is a single tax on the supply of goods and 
services, right from the manufacturing to the consumer. 
Credits of input tax paid at each stage will be available in the 
subsequent stage of value addition, which makes GST 
essentially a tax on value addition at each stage. 
GST will not cover taxes like toll tax, road tax, environment 
tax and others are directly paid by users and will be levied by 
States directly.

FMISC supports flood management through satellite -based river monitoring, centralized GIS

FMISC issues targeted alerts for the public, institutions, and communities.

Whether A stamp paper has validity of Six months? 
As Per Pro visions of Indian Stamp Act, 183 9 and by the various Supreme Court Judgment, 
there is no validity of Stamp Paper on Paper . The Indian Stamp Act, 1899 nowhere prescribes 
any expiry date for use of a Stamp paper. Section 54 of Indian Stamp Act merely provides that a 
person possessing a Stamp paper for which he has no immediate use (which is not spoiled or 
rendered unfit or useless), can seek refund of the value thereof by surrendering such Stamp 
paper to the Collector provided it was purchased within the period of six months next preceding 
the date on which it was so surrendered.  Therefore, there is no impediment for a Stam

document.” 
Only under  Section 52 B ( a) of The Bombay Stamp Act 1958, prescribed the period of six 
months from the date of purchase of Stamp Paper or delivery of Stamp Paper after which the 
Stamps become invalid and it can’t be used after that.  This time period of six months is also 
quantified under the, The Bombay Stamp (Gujarat Amendment Act) 200 0, under Section 52C 
which is applicable in Gujarat also. 
None of the other State Stamp Acts has such provision to limit the validity of Stamps and Stamp 
Papers. 
Conclusion: - State of Gujarat and Maharashtra uses the Validity of Stamp Paper as Six 
Month Period as per the Bombay Stamp Act, 1958 though legally it is not valid in the 
Eye

Provisions of Indian Stamp Act, 1839 and as per the Supreme Court Judgment, there is 
no validity of Stamp Paper on Paper, but in actual the Validity of Stamp Paper is Six 
Months Practically off paper especially in the State of Gujarat and Maharashtra.  This 
trend becomes a practice in the other states.
